tonight.headline: McLaurin's cover is now Allgeier — and Saturday's report still decides
body: Bad news first: Terry McLaurin was limited Thursday and did not practise Friday. Washington list it as a veteran rest day ('Hamstring/NIR (Rest)' on Commanders.com), and the designation comes Saturday. He plays Monday night; his cover locks on Sunday. You added Tyler Allgeier for the idle Vikings defence at 23:08 UTC, so the cover is now Arizona's starter rather than Kamara, who was limited all week with his back.

Everything else is set: the lineup is the projection lineup, 127.0, against Bok-aneers' 112.5, ESPN 57%. One correction to this afternoon: Buffalo's DJ Moore and Josh Palmer are questionable on the final report, not ruled out.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: If McLaurin is ruled out or doubtful on Saturday and nothing moves before Allgeier's 14:05 Sunday kickoff, the flex scores zero — Monday's inactives come too late for any bench option.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A plain questionable, or no designation, on Saturday: McLaurin starts and Allgeier sits.

doFirst.subtitle: Coker to WR, Allgeier to the flex. Only on out or doubtful.

case.label: The news
case.body: McLaurin limited Thursday, DNP Friday; Commanders.com lists Friday as 'Hamstring/NIR (Rest)'. John Keim (ESPN, via RotoWire 16 Oct): a veteran rest day, not a setback. Diggs got back to limited Friday. Final report Saturday.

case.label: The clock
case.body: McLaurin kicks off Monday 18:15 CDMX. Allgeier locks Sunday 14:05, Kamara 11:00. The tool's inactive check, Monday 16:45, is after both, so the move rests on Saturday's designation.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Allgeier: Arizona ruled out Jeremiyah Love (ankle) on the final report (NFL.com); Allgeier already ran more routes and pass-block snaps than Love through five games (Draft Sharks 12 Oct, PFF numbers), so he keeps the passing-down work and gains the early downs. 12.4 projected against Kamara 10.1, who was limited all three days (Saints report 16 Oct).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin is listed doubtful, Allgeier starts, and McLaurin plays Monday and outscores him (archive) — or McLaurin is only questionable, stays in, and is inactive at Monday 16:45.
